core: NF-kB activation downstream of TLR and TNF receptors
qualifier: canonical and non-canonical IKK/NIK arms, without JNK/p38 or NOD branches
name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB activation via TLR and TNFR
rationale: Members are IKK/TAK1/NIK-driven NF-kB signaling from TLRs, TNFR1/TNFSF, CD40 and lymphocyte receptors plus its ubiquitin control; confusables instead carry NOD1/2, inflammasome and JNK/p38 branches.

qualifier: break-induced replication and resolution of recombination intermediates
name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere maintenance by recombination and replication (D-loops, t-circles, capping) with BIR and mitotic recombination intermediate resolution; confusables lack BIR and instead carry C-strand synthesis, R-loop and fork reversal terms.

name: Myocardial and endocardial morphogenesis with cardiomyocyte proliferation control
rationale: Members build the heart wall (trabecular/compact myocardium, endocardium, septum, coronary vessels) and regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation and differentiation; confusables lack endocardium or the proliferation/differentiation regulators and add hypertrophy, regeneration or heart-tube patterning.

name: Endosome-plasma membrane trafficking and receptor recycling
rationale: Members move proteins between plasma membrane and endosomes (endocytic and receptor recycling, endosome organization, constitutive secretion); confusables centre on Golgi-endosome-lysosome retrograde routes and Rab GAP signaling.

qualifier: suppression of NHEJ, recombination and telomerase at telomeres
name: Telomere capping and end protection
rationale: Members all concern protecting telomere ends (capping, packaging, inhibiting NHEJ, recombination and telomerase access); confusables carry telomere replication/D-loop processing or telomerase/Cajal body recruitment instead.

name: Satellite cell and myoblast control in muscle regeneration
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate myoblast/satellite cell proliferation, differentiation and fusion in skeletal muscle regeneration; confusables carry myogenesis, fate commitment and fiber differentiation terms instead.

name: BCR signaling and B cell development
rationale: Most members are B cell development, homeostasis, proliferation and BCR signaling (BTK, RAS, CD22, second messengers); confusables lack the proximal BCR cascade and add plasma cell, germinal centre and B cell surface signatures.

name: Mitosis with APC/C-controlled anaphase and mitotic exit
rationale: Members span mitotic entry, spindle, cohesion, condensation, nuclear envelope and cytokinesis; every confusable lacks the APC/C ubiquitin ligase regulation (Cdc20/Cdh1, Emi1, K11 chains) and mitotic exit that this theme has.

qualifier: negative regulation of splicing and decay
name: mRNA stabilization and inhibition of splicing and decay
rationale: Members protect or restrain mRNA processing (stabilization, inhibition of NMD/deadenylation decay and splicing, export, translation); confusables are miRNA silencing, mRNA decay/polyadenylation machinery or ARE-mediated destabilization.

qualifier: de novo synthesis including phosphatidylglycerol and cardiolipin
name: De novo glycerophospholipid and cardiolipin biosynthesis
rationale: Members synthesize PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin via CDP-intermediates; confusables add phospholipid hydrolysis, scrambling or acyl-chain remodeling of PC/PE/PI/PS.

name: Sphingolipid and glycosphingolipid synthesis and lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members synthesize, transport and lysosomally degrade ceramide, sphingomyelin and gangliosides; confusables carry GPI anchor and amino-sugar metabolism or amide metabolism instead.

name: Notch and Hedgehog signaling with regulated receptor proteolysis
rationale: Members are Notch and Hedgehog/GLI signaling plus gamma-secretase-type intramembrane proteolysis and Hh autoprocessing; confusables lack Hedgehog, lack Notch, or are dominated by Wnt/beta-catenin.

name: Behavioral stress, fear and ethanol drinking responses
rationale: Members are CRH/corticosterone-linked behavioral stress responses including fear and alcohol drinking; confusables add HPA hormone secretion, mating/parental behavior or neuropeptide signaling.

name: Transcriptional control and restraint of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members regulate myeloid progenitor commitment, mostly negatively, via transcriptional programs (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis); confusables carry positive regulation, neutrophil/dendritic differentiation and monocyte trafficking.

qualifier: thrombin, ADP and thromboxane receptor signaling
name: Platelet activation by thrombin, ADP and thromboxane receptors
rationale: Members are platelet activation, aggregation and coagulation driven by PAR, P2Y, TP and prostacyclin receptors; confusables lack these agonist receptors and add GPIb/collagen adhesion or integrin/Rap1 signaling.

name: Amino acid metabolism with histidine and threonine catabolism
rationale: Members are general amino/organic acid metabolism plus histidine and threonine catabolism; confusables carry aromatic, proline, glycine and sulfur amino acid pathways instead.

name: Cardiomyocyte growth, hypertrophic adaptation and contractile force regulation
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy, regeneration and contraction; confusables are vascular smooth muscle programs or lack the contraction/heart-rate terms.

qualifier: cell fate decisions rather than receptor activation
name: Nuclear Notch target transcription in cell fate decisions
rationale: Members are Notch intracellular domain-driven transcription (HLH targets, Th2 and pancreatic fate); confusables carry NOTCH1 activation, nuclear translocation and oncogenic mutant signaling.

core: Eicosanoid synthesis by P450 and lipoxygenases
name: P450 and lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis and inherited defects
rationale: Members oxidize arachidonic and linoleic acid via epoxygenase, omega-hydroxylase and lipoxygenase plus disease variants of these enzymes; confusables carry leukotriene/eicosanoid catabolism and omega-oxidation instead.

name: Sensory gating, vocal learning and social behavior
rationale: Members are sensory-driven and social behaviors (touch, vision, audition, vocal and observational learning, prepulse inhibition) with limbic/striatal development; confusables are motor, locomotor and grooming behaviors.

name: Endocardial cushion-derived valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members form valves and septa from endocardial cushions via EMT; confusables lack septal morphogenesis or carry myocardial trabeculation and aorta development.

qualifier: both TCR and BCR with CD28/CTLA4/BTLA co-signaling
name: Proximal TCR and BCR signaling with costimulatory checkpoints
rationale: Members are proximal TCR and BCR signaling plus CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA coinhibition; one confusable lacks the T cell side, the others lack the B cell side.

name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and calcium uptake
rationale: Members import, process and degrade mitochondrial proteins and regulate mitochondrial calcium entry; confusables lack calcium uptake and add cristae formation and fusion.

qualifier: ventricular myocardium, endocardium and coronary vessels
name: Ventricular myocardium, endocardium and coronary vessel morphogenesis
rationale: Members build trabecular/compact myocardium, endocardium, muscular septum and coronary vasculature; confusables carry valves, aorta, right ventricle or membranous/atrial septum instead.

qualifier: PERK and IRE1 arms with stress translational control
name: PERK/IRE1 unfolded protein response and stress translational control
rationale: Members regulate ER stress signaling through PERK and IRE1 and stress-induced translational repression; confusables are ATF6 chaperone induction or HRI/GCN2 integrated stress response.
